comment_keyword_secret_tool.description: Tell a tiny story where a character is stuck on a file problem and finds a 'secret' free fix. End on a big caption asking viewers to comment one keyword to get the link.
comment_keyword_secret_tool.hook_pattern: Secret [everyday task] app nobody tells you about, comment '[WORD]' and I'll DM the link

free_thing_keyword_gate.description: Open with a character who is about to pay or struggle for something, then reveal that a free tool does it. Close with a caption telling viewers to comment a keyword.
free_thing_keyword_gate.hook_pattern: Free [thing that normally costs money or has ads], comment '[WORD]' for the link

impossible_without_reveal.description: Show a character facing a problem that needs a pain (such as an upload limit or a locked file). Reveal the tool solving it without that pain, in three short steps on a panel.
impossible_without_reveal.hook_pattern: This [gadget or tool] does [impossible-sounding thing] without [usual requirement]

numbered_list_explainer.description: Use a narrator and a counter caption to run through N quick file-fixes, each one a tiny 3D scene with a before and after size panel.
numbered_list_explainer.hook_pattern: N new [things] in [trending update] you need to know
